title: Guidance: Re-render InfiniteHits based on time without calling search api
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe 🙏**
I have an index that contains Restaurants where each restaurant has a specific open/close time and location which depending on the day of week/time in the object.  Depending on the time when the Restaurant object is rendered, it may appear in my results or not.  I'm looking for a way to re-render my current results as the time changes without making a new API call.

**Describe the solution you'd like 🤔**
I want to re-render a Custom Component that is wrapped in the connectInfiniteHits without making an additional call to the Algolia API.

**Describe alternatives you've considered ✨**
My first reaction is to use a piece of state that is updated every minute that is used as part of the key in the render, but I think that would call the Algolia API to get more results

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.

I'm looking for guidance on how I would re-render a Custom Component using connectInfiniteHits.
